problems.statement: With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, `bin/dice` stops with `DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`, unless the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active.
problems.code_says: The check runs only where the state path is resolved. `state_path()` has three callers in `bin/dice`: `_secure_runtime_tree` (line 598) and `Daemon.__init__` (lines 1926 and 1952). On a shared host without the test override, `ensure_daemon` returns at lines 4147 to 4154, before `ensure_runtime_dir`. So client commands of `bin/dice` (`submit`, `queue`, `cancel`) never call `state_path()`. They ignore the variable and do not stop. Only the daemon stops at startup. `bin/slice` also stops, with `error: DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`, in the commands that read the state file (`dice_state_snapshot`, bin/slice:5393, called from bin/slice:952, 6028, 6214 and 6262). The sibling rows `DICE_LOCK_PATH` and `DICE_LOG_PATH` already say `A client ignores the variable there`.
problems.corrected_cell: Moves the file in which the Dice daemon records its running, queued and finished work. `bin/slice` reads the same file. Only tests can use it. With `mode: shared` in `/etc/positron/dice.yaml`, a Dice daemon with this variable does not start. It prints `DICE_STATE_PATH is test-only in shared Dice`. A `bin/slice` command that reads the state file stops with the same message. A client command of `bin/dice`, such as `submit`, ignores the variable there. The check does not apply while the test override `DICE_TEST_HOST_CONFIG_PATH` is active. The Dice daemon runs only with `mode: shared`. Without that override, the daemon removes the variable from the environment of programs it starts.

problems.statement: A failed creation only logs the warning `Could not create FUSE mount point`.
problems.code_says: The warning is only the first result. `ensure_mountpoint` logs it and returns (src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp:99 to 107). The directory then does not exist, so the later mount fails. `fuse_sysfs::mount` throws `Failed to mount FUSE filesystem at <path>` (src/system/fuse_sysfs.cpp:361 to 365). `runtron` catches it, prints `error initializing FUSE stats: ...` and returns 1 (src/runtron.cpp:506 to 509). `rinzler` calls `stats::start()` outside any try block (src/rinzler.cpp:4988), so the exception ends the program. The header comment says the same: the helper does not throw, and a later step reports the error (h/system/fuse_helpers.hpp:34 to 38). A reader who follows the row expects the program to keep running.
problems.corrected_cell: Directory path, used as given. An empty value counts as unset. The program creates a missing directory. A failed creation logs the warning `Could not create FUSE mount point`. The mount then fails with `Failed to mount FUSE filesystem at <path>`. `runtron` prints `error initializing FUSE stats` and exits with status 1. `rinzler` aborts on the same error. Unset: `/opt/positron/stats`. A program whose file path contains `/gen/` uses `<repository root>/stats`, and `REPO_ROOT_OVERRIDE` replaces the repository root.
